title: What Settings Can Edit
content: Settings can edit operational lookup data such as call types, supervisor reasons, show offers, donor profiles, fail reasons, and coaching categories.

title: What Settings Cannot Edit
content: Help, Tutorial, and Discord/system messages are non-editable content and do not appear in Settings.

title: Review Submit Rules
content: Review does not auto-submit. Generate or edit summaries, resolve blocking validation, then submit explicitly.

title: Common Newbie Shift Mistakes
content: Common issues include skipping transfer follow-up dates, using Other reasons prematurely, and attempting submit before summary generation.

title: Why Call 3 Sometimes Disappears
content: Call 3 is shown only when at least one of Call 1 or Call 2 fails. If both pass, Call 3 is hidden by business rule.
